strategy.gamePlan: Kageki into Kizan is the whole deck: two bodies from one normal summon, a Synchro on turn one, and a Six Samurai United that draws two off the same play. You are trying to end the game by turn four before the control decks find their traps. Every hand is judged on one question — does it make Shi En this turn?
openingPriorities: Kageki first, always. It special summons a Samurai from hand and turns a one-card hand into a Synchro play.
Do not overextend into an open backrow once you already have lethal in two turns. Three zones means one Wall of Disruption can undo the whole board.
Six Samurai United only pays off if you keep summoning. Chain it in response to removal rather than losing the counters.
keyInteractions: Shi En negates the first Spell or Trap each turn, so lead with your worse threat and let it eat the negate.
Fuma is a Tuner and a searcher in one body; Enishi bounces a monster on summon when you already control a Six Samurai.
Forbidden Lance keeps an attacker alive through most traps and lets a 1800 body run over a 2500 that was pumped.

matchups.notes: They answer the swarm turn with one card. Bait the trap with a single body before committing the second.
You kill on turn three or four; they need five. Ignore their board and push damage.
Shi En outsizes almost everything they open on, and they cannot recover a lost body.
